title: SLA-aware incremental materialized views for cross-tenant anomaly detection and fast console queries
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Console currently runs a mixture of heavy ad-hoc queries against wide event tables to detect tenant SLA regressions and surface alerts. These queries are expensive, frequently time out for large tenants, and do not support low-latency dashboard slices used by on-call and account teams. Goal: introduce SLA-aware incremental materialized views (MVs) that maintain compact, queryable aggregates and anomaly flags per tenant/route/interval, optimized for sub-second console lookups and efficient scheduled anomaly scans. The MVs will be maintained incrementally from existing callstream and route-telemetry sources, use sketch summaries for latency quantiles, include cost/token aggregates, and expose a narrow canonical schema for console and alerting consumers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A new materialized view (mv_tenant_route_sla) exists in the warehouse with documented schema and is populated by incremental jobs.
2) Console dashboard queries for a tenant + route median/p95 and SLA-violation flag return within 1s for top-500 tenants (based on invocation volume) and within 3s for arbitrary tenants.
3) End-to-end anomaly scan (daily job) completes within SLA and raises the same set of alerts as the reference offline job for >=98% of historical anomalies (precision/recall baseline).
4) Backfill procedure and migration playbook documented; can rehydrate 90 days of history within 6 hours using existing compute budget.
5) Metrics: update job cost remains <= 15% of current daily warehouse ETL cost; storage overhead of new MVs < 12% of raw event table size via compaction and sketching.
tech_design: Schema: mv_tenant_route_sla columns = [event_date, tenant_id, route_id, window_start_ts, window_end_ts, inv_count, token_sum, latency_tdigest_base64, p50_est_ms, p95_est_ms, sla_violations_count, last_watermark_ts, sketch_version, model_variant_counts]. Incremental maintenance: CDC-style micro-batches consume callstream deltas (from pubsub->staging) into a transformation job that upserts into MV partitions by event_date. Quantiles computed with t-digest (stored as compressed base64) to avoid wide percentile scans. Dedup and idempotency: use invocation_hash + last_watermark_ts windowing to ignore late duplicates; ingestion keeps a max-seen-invocation_ts per partition for safe replays. Partitioning/clustering: partition by event_date; cluster by tenant_id, route_id for locality. Hot-cold: recent 3 days kept in streaming partitions with frequent updates; older partitions are compacted and only store final aggregates and sketches. Query patterns: simple single-row reads for current-tenant SLA status; small-range time series for 7/30-day trends via precomputed deltas. Sketch UDFs: provide SQL functions decode_tdigest, merge_tdigest, quantile_from_tdigest. Backfill: parallelized re-aggregation with sharded map-reduce job using date-range splits. Observability: expose job-level metrics (lag, update duration, rows_upserted), approximation error metrics for sketches, and storage growth. Rollout: start with opt-in beta for 10 pilot tenants, then expand to top-500 tenants by invocation volume before global promotion.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: implement MV schema and incremental transformer; run in dry-run mode producing vanity tables for validation (2 weeks). Phase 2: enable for 10 pilot tenants and compare alert congruence with current pipeline (1 week). Phase 3: extend to top-500 tenants and enable console read path for SLA widgets behind feature flag (2 weeks). Phase 4: full migration, decommission heavy ad-hoc query paths and document cost savings (1 week). Each phase gated by performance and correctness checkpoints; rollback by switching console to legacy queries and reverting feature flag.
comments: 2025-01-12 - Ava Martinez: Initial spike completed. Verified t-digest accuracy on sampled tenant data; merge performance is acceptable. Next: author MV schema and incremental job skeleton.

2025-01-22 - Dev Patel: Implemented transform prototype; ingest latency under 2s for streaming window tests. Noted that token_sum for very large tenants causes skew; proposing a small hash-based sharding for backfills.
2025-02-05 - Priya Singh (SRE): Add checkpointing and job-level circuit breaker to avoid runaway cost during backfills; recommend safe default concurrency limits.

2025-02-14 - Product (Marcus Lee): Confirmed dashboard UX changes — SLA widget will read from mv_tenant_route_sla when feature flag enabled. Need explicit contract for fields and freshness SLA (5m for streaming partition).

2025-02-21 - Dev Patel: Pilot deployment to 10 tenants started. Early results: query latencies for pilot tenants median 420ms; p95 ~980ms. Investigating two outlier tenants with high cardinality model_variant_counts leading to MV bloat.
